column1: # headscale config.yaml policy variants, shared by test-headscale-policy-fallback.sh (offline)
# and test-headscale-policy-fallback-live.sh (pinned headscale). Each row is a sed program
# applied to a config whose policy block is exactly
# and what headscale's own `dumpConfig` then reports for policy.mode and policy.path
# ("-" = no path). The live suite MEASURES those two columns against the real binary
# (and against what `headscale serve` loads); the offline suite's dumpConfig stub
# replays them. Fields are TAB-separated; lines starting with # are comments.
